a0_interpretation_gate.aggregation: median over the 16 hypotheses per generator
a0_interpretation_gate.exceptional_values: any missing/non-finite m or SE, <2 trials, or zero/non-finite mean(SE^2) => U = NaN; trials never dropped; a NaN or absent U for either generator => gate UNDETERMINED (listed, never omitted from the median); UNDETERMINED treated conservatively as non-informative
a0_interpretation_gate.hypothesis_set: the 16 hypotheses of variants.K16 of the frozen config (known_null_v2_config.json list)

labels.not_triggered: PASS (B on the repeated-simulation process; A0 as a conditional randomisation diagnostic on these seven sessions)

a0_interpretation_gate.limit: can downgrade A0's evidential contribution; cannot show B is representative of market data or that A0 reproduces the original DGP
a0_interpretation_gate.lost_difficulty: median U(A0) <= 1.0 and median U(B) > 1.0 (1.0 is a declared diagnostic rule, not a validated boundary)
a0_interpretation_gate.m: S2 (gross) session-mean statistic of one hypothesis, bps per round trip, one value per trial (A0: per derangement; B: per independent trial); SE_CR1 the per-trial CR1 SE of the same statistic
a0_interpretation_gate.nature: interpretive only; not a significance test; no effect on rejection counts
a0_interpretation_gate.never_overrides_rate_failure: an A0 cell > 55 of 1854 (or a B cell > 60 of 2000) is FAIL even if the gate says A0 non-informative
a0_interpretation_gate.understatement_ratio: U = sd_trials(m, ddof=1) / sqrt(mean_trials(SE_CR1^2)), per hypothesis and generator

thresholds_draft.a0_label: conditional randomisation diagnostic (not a size estimate)
thresholds_draft.adoption_scope_if_passed: CR1+Student-t Webb enumeration, G=7, Holm, multi7 + generator B, K=3/6/16 at 0.025 only; no claim at 0.05 or elsewhere

centring_invariant.empty_or_invalid_group: fails (never skipped); infinite label fails; NaN labels excluded from the mean
centring_invariant.groups: (name, horizon) pairs of the frozen hypothesis lists (1s x AAPL/MSFT/QQQ; 10s, 1m x AAPL/MSFT) x 7 sessions
centring_invariant.meaning: passing establishes only that centring was implemented; not exchangeability, dependence assumptions, tail behaviour or validity of the conditional randomisation scheme
centring_invariant.role: HARD construction check on the centred A0 labels before the derangement; failure => A0 run aborted/INVALID (construction failure, not a statistical null-validity finding)
centring_invariant.rule: |mean of finite labels| <= tol_rel * max|label| per (name, horizon, session) group
centring_invariant.series_used_check: derangement input bit-identical to the checked centred array

thresholds_draft.claim_scope: B pass: observed FWER in the specified independent synthetic trials met the pre-specified calibration threshold. A0 pass: exact conditional rejection proportion over the specified transformations met its threshold. Neither, alone or combined, proves true FWER on real trading data is controlled at 2.5 %.
thresholds_draft.further_attempt: at most one; written rationale before results; CR2/CR3 = new procedure; failure => F3 unattained at G=7 under approaches tested

null_validity_check.a0_role: descriptive only: reported, no verdict, no NULL BIASED, no invalidation
null_validity_check.b_role: blocks_pass: a flag => FAIL (generator B NULL BIASED); to be confirmed by the reviewer
null_validity_check.label: residual-mean diagnostic: DESCRIPTIVE for A0 (uncalibrated heuristic; false-flag 0.22 % iid dependence, 34.9 % with session effects); for B retains its blocking role
null_validity_check.outcome_on_flag: B only: FAIL (generator B NULL BIASED); A0: none

se.A0: heuristic sd/sqrt(7), NOT calibrated, no <0.1 % claim

null_validity_check.self_test: implemented: python/tests/test_known_null_diag.py (module iap.research.known_null_diag); rates in protocol 3.3 (kept in the audit trail)

order_size_shares.note: order size in SHARES per decision passed to build_trips (known_null.py) and part of the v1/v2 identity thresholds; kept at 100 for comparability with v1 and v2; not a count of registrations

pass_rule.meaning_of_threshold: pre-specified calibration acceptance threshold (3.0 %), not proof of 2.5 % size control

option_B_screen.claim: permissive rejection-rate screen only; no 2.5 % size-control claim

primary_cells.definition: generators A0, B x statistics S1, S2 x K = 3, 6, 16; A_v2 and R0 diagnostic only

thresholds_draft.primary_endpoint: family-wise error rate at family level per cell (generator x statistic x K); per-hypothesis marginal rates descriptive

A_v2_diagnostic.label: reproduction of the v2 failure mechanism; strictly diagnostic

thresholds_draft.verdict_logic: INVALID if centring invariant fails; FAIL if any of 12 cells > threshold or missing, or B flagged; else PASS labelled by the gate; implemented as primary_verdict
